one_intervention_pseudocode: At the selected ordinary training chunk[r:r+2000], clone/detach its real incoming student h_r and separately its EMA h_ema_r before the normal forward.
Run the existing main+aux+EMA-consistency forward/loss/backward/unscale/clip exactly as usual on that chunk.

BEFORE scaler.step or EMA update, rerun only inputs[r:r+2000] under no_grad and the SAME autocast precision/current PRE-UPDATE weights. Control initializes from saved h_r; candidate initializes from zero. Discard every replay output and retain only detached final h as the next ordinary chunk incoming state.
Separately rerun EMA with its own saved h_ema_r(control) or zero(candidate), still before updating EMA weights. Never feed student h into EMA or use the real-data cachedteacher state.

Then execute exactly one original scaler.step/update,scheduler step and EMA parameter update. Remaining chunks proceed normally. Replay also occurs on an AMP-skipped attempt; no extra optimizer/backward/EMA/scaler/scheduler operations are introduced.
why_control_is_specific: Replaying before the optimizer update avoids confounding zero-origin treatment with refresh under newer weights. With dropout0, unchanged normalization and same full2000 forward shape, control replay reconstructs the same outgoing state as its original pass; it preserves original stale-carry semantics. Candidate removes history before r only after a2000-row causal burn-in. Both pay exactly one extra student+EMA forward, neither adds loss on replay rows.
teacher_consistency: Fixed external teacher predictions remain original full-origin cached supervision for identical rows in botharms; no re-inference/target changes. Student and ownEMA use matched origin rules but their own weights/states. Full-origin external teacher versus shortened student context is intentional context augmentation, not evidence that shorter history is sufficient.
minimum_preflight_if_later_allocated: Generated dropout0 ordinary model: control replay before optimizer step equals direct outgoing h and complete original training outputs/gradients/AdamW/EMA state across twochunks; candidate first changes next-chunk state, not already computed current loss.

Generated cloned pair: identical initial parameters/RNG,rowselection,all loss denominators,update/EMA/scheduler counts; replay creates no autograd graph or extra parameter gradients. Forced AMP skip obeys identical attempt clock.
